s4-lore-kraken.vo: Nobody knows where the Doomscroll Kraken came from. They say he was once a brilliant student. One night, at 2 a.m., he opened just one more video. He never resurfaced. Now, he waits inside everyone's phone. In HabitQuest, every quest you finish cuts one tentacle.

s7-doc-streaks.vo: Your brain is wired to break streaks. Here's the fix. Missing one day doesn't break a habit. What matters is repeating it over time. The hardest part isn't being perfect. It's the comeback. So the trick is making the comeback easy. That's why HabitQuest freezes your streak, halves the XP on hard days, and never punishes you.

As a kid, he made *one* promise.
Someone told him: if you don't fight… you *can't* win.
So every night, alone, in front of a *mirror…*
And one day, he lifted the boulder *nobody* could move.
